key.name: shortcut
key.description: Global keybinding to toggle the ClipVault floating clipboard popup

key.name: history-size
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned history items to retain

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When true, clipboard changes are not recorded

key.name: history-expiration-days
key.description: 0 means never expire automatically, otherwise delete unpinned items older than N days

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: Window wm_class or app IDs whose copies should be ignored

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the floating popup in pixels

key.name: popup-max-height
key.description: Maximum height of the floating popup in pixels

key.name: enable-images
key.description: Store image clips in addition to text

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Enable verbose extension logging without logging clipboard content
